cases.title: Add New Bookmark to Specified Folder
cases.description: Verify that a new bookmark can be added into a specific location within the bookmarks hierarchy.

cases.title: Add Bookmark Invalid URL
cases.description: Verify that adding a bookmark with an invalid URL format is handled correctly.

cases.title: Delete an existing bookmark normally
cases.description: Delete an existing bookmark from the bookmarks list and verify it is removed from the bookmarks file and no longer displayed from all access points.

cases.title: Delete a non-existent bookmark ID
cases.description: Attempt to delete a non-existent bookmark ID and verify proper error handling without affecting existing bookmarks.

cases.title: Add and Delete Bookmark from Personal Toolbar
cases.description: Verify that a bookmark can be successfully added to and deleted from the personal toolbar.

cases.title: Delete Locked Item from Toolbar Abnormal Handling
cases.description: Verify that deleting an item from the personal toolbar fails appropriately when the item is locked.

cases.title: Insert New Folder into Hierarchy
cases.description: Verify that a new bookmark folder can be successfully inserted into a specific location within the bookmarks hierarchy.

cases.title: Insert Duplicate Folder Name
cases.description: Verify that inserting a folder with a duplicate name in the same parent folder handles the condition appropriately according to application rules.

cases.title: Launch bookmark via double-click
cases.description: Double-clicking on a valid bookmark in the list causes it to be launched in a new browser window.

cases.title: Double-click bookmark with broken link
cases.description: Double-clicking a bookmark that contains a broken or dead link displays an appropriate error or handles the failed navigation gracefully without crashing.

cases.title: Verify default packaged bookmarks contain valid links
cases.description: Verify that all bookmarks within the default bookmarks file packaged with the browser contain valid HTTP or HTTPS links.

cases.title: Verify detection of malformed default links
cases.description: Verify that the browser correctly identifies and flags malformed links within the default bookmarks file.

cases.title: Edit bookmark name and URL and save
cases.description: Modify an existing bookmark's name and URL attributes and successfully save the changes without losing item integrity.

cases.title: Modify item attributes during low disk space
cases.description: Attempt to save changes to a bookmark item under low disk space conditions to ensure integrity handling.

cases.title: Delete Existing Bookmark Folder
cases.description: Verify that an existing bookmark folder can be successfully deleted from the bookmarks hierarchy.

cases.title: Prevent Deletion of System-Protected Root Folder
cases.description: Verify that attempting to delete a system-protected root folder is prevented and handled as an abnormal scenario.

cases.title: Add and Delete Bookmark Separator
cases.description: Verify that a bookmark separator can be successfully added to the bookmarks hierarchy and subsequently deleted.

cases.title: Delete Non-Existent Separator
cases.description: Verify that attempting to delete a non-existent bookmark separator handles the error appropriately without affecting other items.

cases.title: Save bookmark changes and restart browser normally
cases.description: Verify that all changes made to bookmarks are successfully saved to the bookmarks file after performing a normal browser restart.

cases.title: Save changes immediately followed by simulated browser crash
cases.description: Verify that bookmark changes remain intact and persist properly when a simulated browser crash occurs immediately after saving.

cases.title: Execute negative view properties for folders and separators
cases.description: Verify that executing view properties on bookmarks folders and separators yields negative or restricted results as specified.

cases.title: Force property execution on unsupported item types
cases.description: Attempt to force property execution on unsupported item types to ensure proper negative handling.

cases.title: Inline Rename Bookmark Normal Scenario
cases.description: Rename an existing bookmark directly inline within the view without using the bookmarks properties dialog.

cases.title: Inline Rename Bookmark Abnormal Scenario
cases.description: Attempt to enter an empty string or forbidden characters during an inline rename of a bookmark and verify handling.

cases.title: Find bookmark using assigned custom keyword
cases.description: Verify that a bookmark can be successfully found by entering its assigned user-defined custom keyword in the search or address bar.

cases.title: Search with non-existent keyword
cases.description: Verify that searching with a non-existent custom keyword returns no matching bookmarks and handles the empty result gracefully.

cases.title: Sort and reverse-sort columns
cases.description: Verify that bookmark columns can be successfully sorted in ascending order and reverse-sorted in descending order.

cases.title: Sort columns with mixed case and numeric strings
cases.description: Verify proper sorting behavior when columns contain a mix of uppercase, lowercase, and numeric string values.

analysis.analysis: R-001: Normal: Add a new bookmark into a specified folder in hierarchy. Edge: Add bookmark into root or deepest nested folder. Boundary: Add bookmark with maximum length URL and title. Abnormal: Add bookmark with invalid URL format. R-002: Normal: Delete an existing bookmark. Edge: Delete the last remaining bookmark in a folder. Abnormal: Delete a non-existent bookmark ID. R-003: Normal: Add and delete a bookmark directly from the personal toolbar. Edge: Add bookmark when toolbar is fully populated. Abnormal: Delete from toolbar when item is locked. R-004: Normal: Insert a new folder into hierarchy. Edge: Insert nested folder up to maximum depth. Abnormal: Insert folder with duplicate name in same parent. R-005: Normal: Double-click bookmark to launch in browser window. Edge: Double-click multiple bookmarks rapidly. Abnormal: Double-click bookmark with broken or dead link. R-006: Normal: Verify all default packaged bookmarks contain valid HTTP/HTTPS links. Edge: Verify links with redirect URLs. Abnormal: Verify detection of malformed default links. R-007: Normal: Edit bookmark name and URL and save. Edge: Modify item attributes during low disk space. Abnormal: Save corrupted data structure. R-008: Normal: Delete an existing bookmark folder. Edge: Delete a folder containing numerous subfolders and items. Abnormal: Delete a system-protected root folder. R-009: Normal: Add and delete a bookmark separator. Edge: Add consecutive separators. Abnormal: Delete non-existent separator. R-010: Normal: Save changes and restart browser normally. Edge: Save changes immediately followed by simulated browser crash. Abnormal: Crash during active write operation to bookmarks file. R-011: Normal: Execute negative view properties for folders and separators. Edge: Access properties of uninitialized items. Abnormal: Force property execution on unsupported item types. R-012: Normal: Rename bookmark inline in the view. Edge: Rename bookmark using maximum allowed characters. Abnormal: Enter empty string or forbidden characters during inline rename. R-013: Normal: Find bookmark using assigned custom keyword. Edge: Find bookmark with keyword containing special characters. Abnormal: Search with non-existent keyword. R-014: Normal: Sort and reverse-sort columns. Edge: Sort columns with mixed case and numeric strings. Abnormal: Sort non-sortable columns. R-015: Normal: Resize bookmark columns to display full entries. Edge: Resize column to minimum and maximum possible widths. Abnormal: Resize column beyond window boundaries. R-016: Normal: Show and hide bookmark columns. Edge: Hide all optional columns. Abnormal: Hide all columns including mandatory identifier column. R-017: Normal: Select and delete multiple bookmarks simultaneously. Edge: Delete all bookmarks in a folder at once. Abnormal: Delete an empty selection of bookmarks. R-018: Normal: Prevent dropping a bookmark onto itself, immediate parent, or child. Edge: Drop bookmark onto a sibling item. Abnormal: Force drag-and-drop onto self via API manipulation.
